notes:
## Changes since `v0.5.2`

### Features

- let Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi tell tTerm when they work, wait for the user, finish or fail, through hooks and plugins installed from the notification settings that write the report to their own terminal, so tabs show the agent's state and its waits and finished turns are announced, also inside tmux ([3f9426e9](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/3f9426e9144c6e61708ef5dbdf801bb391b62430))
- tell the user when a long command finishes, a program asks for a notification (OSC 9, 777, 99) or a terminal rings while they look elsewhere, with system notifications that lead back to their tab, toasts and dots on tabs out of sight, and sign the macOS bundle ad hoc so the notification center accepts it ([7583b3a4](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/7583b3a481b967c618481f55b1612b0799b1553c))
- let local bash, zsh and fish on macOS and Linux mark their commands through an opt-in shell integration ([95a0c1d9](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/95a0c1d98270faec811e6cd89d11364442d32da3))
- download a multi-selection from the SFTP context menu or the selection toolbar into one folder as a single batch ([1447a6d9](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/1447a6d989a4163965d36ad40e4920cdef1443c6))
- drag across SFTP rows to multi-select without turning on selection mode first, with Shift/Cmd-click and Escape to leave ([893d9cce](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/893d9cceec1037a8b95a0032f3ee6544bf68f2b7))
- pick a saved connection from the search box with the up and down arrows and connect with Enter ([1fa6cfa8](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/1fa6cfa8c8d7d4e6e49dcfcc7d780abdb9f0f5d5))
- show a green or red dot beside each finished command's prompt, since the scrollbar merges nearby marks of one color ([6f801cc6](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/6f801cc6028c447e87bc8369931fbf20a734f654))
- name local terminal tabs after the shell they start, numbering repeats, instead of OS terminal ([a2cdddc4](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/a2cdddc4dee2b780985c2b4a243d7079f41fd4cb))
- reset a garbled terminal from the context menu or a shortcut, including the console behind a local Windows shell, and redraw the prompt when the shell waits at one ([15743e65](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/15743e65f93df0318191b6a841fdda12b1465436))

### Fixes

- keep the theme's background color at zero alpha under the window blur instead of transparent black, so the WebGL renderer, which paints the selection opaque, blends it with the theme instead of darkening it over black ([3279ec65](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/3279ec65674e491df9e9477ef576d71081705719))
- keep dialogs to their own width when they hold a long unbroken line, which pushed the multiline paste preview and the Cancel and Paste buttons out past the dialog's edge, and let the preview scroll sideways instead ([e13ec643](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e13ec6431f04db7f21b8ad89b34e1d22b692b621))
- let terminal, SFTP and editor shortcuts act on the focused split pane only instead of on every pane in sight, which cleared, reset, searched or filled a saved password into all of them, and put the keyboard in a pane in sight once it becomes the focused one from the tab bar, a shortcut or a closed tab ([e19acfb4](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e19acfb476f4a154bc4a82ecf2f70461af14e96c))
- announce notifications from a split pane in sight while the user types in another one, closing the toast once that pane gets the focus, and put the keyboard in the terminal a notification leads back to instead of leaving it on the closed toast or the other pane ([67992341](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/6799234132e256634de168d617429feeb5de5865))
- grow unlimited scrollback with its content instead of reserving ten million lines per terminal, and let go of the lines a clear drops, keeping the scroll regions running programs set ([0edc52ac](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/0edc52ac2c4cf730b8a139c8f673432ffcda64e2))
- stop pinning xterm's atlas page canvases in the font host, so pages the canvas renderer replaces as its glyph atlas grows can be collected instead of piling up hundreds of megabytes ([646de472](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/646de472c54582ceeef49b8e1326b3090c534659))
- let the Enter or Escape that ends an IME composition on macOS stay with the input method instead of submitting, closing or navigating text fields ([b7e73ac9](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/b7e73ac987249269f5c073322be09c687eabaeeb))
- keep IME text that WebKit delivers before its keydown whenever no keydown diff is pending, so punctuation typed while the previous key or Caps Lock is still down is no longer dropped either ([5382a481](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/5382a481e9cde87c1a6980bb5c68f45f88dd27c1))
- stop dropping the first IME punctuation typed with Shift held on macOS, which WebKit delivers before its keydown while xterm still counts the held Shift as a key in flight ([66966b2e](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/66966b2ed9cd42d36c43a133af0286001a971aea))
- keep tTerm Dev's credential store key apart from the installed app's and reuse a key already there, so neither locks the other's saved passwords, and report locked passwords instead of a missing one ([85ff1c30](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/85ff1c3054794644fcaf71fd828cbb48d795a80b))
- tint the blurred window while the page is hidden, so it no longer comes back from the Dock as an empty frame with only its traffic lights ([bfba37f1](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/bfba37f183e47327492a0d4d91affd5629106234))
- back up and restore recent quick connections with the settings, like recent commands ([4c7e6217](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/4c7e6217614e0e008aec111373379a11b801a23a))
- sync the multi-line paste confirmation setting, which was left out of the synced settings ([5f9af9a9](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/5f9af9a9f991fce3efe1c90fe796265862ad9ca7))
- start new WSL tabs in the Linux home like Windows Terminal, instead of the shell-integration folder or the Windows home ([4f3821c5](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/4f3821c5eb4973b7c63d29e29764dcc88ae2da7c))
- pause terminal output until xterm.js acknowledges what it parsed, so cat on a large file no longer freezes the window ([dfd5d3a0](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/dfd5d3a065088c4a285a6cb769fea85da8ce7c44))

### Performance

- draw terminals with WebGL by default on macOS too, which keeps one canvas per terminal where the canvas renderer kept four full-size layers and used over a gigabyte for two windows, and release the renderer of a terminal out of sight for a configurable time, ten seconds by default, freeing its canvases and GL context at once and drawing it again before the first frame it is back in sight ([69bb5162](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/69bb51629e695debcf76d6d703ca4702f2ba44e5))

### UI and usability

- show toasts in the top right under the tab bar and the split pane headers instead of over the tabs, keep them open while the pointer is on them or the window is in the background, close a tab's toast once the user looks at the tab, and stack up to a configurable number of them, three by default ([aee8cbe0](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/aee8cbe0234e3636d93b4e22d0b16bd76b0ecbd8))

### Other changes

- explain in the multiline paste confirmation that each line break acts as Enter, so the shell runs the pasted lines right away ([025b4c5b](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/025b4c5bc3302b213108e9561881e538584c179b))

**Full comparison:** [v0.5.2...v0.5.3](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/compare/v0.5.2...v0.5.3)
